title: Early 21st Century Art

description.main: A pocket-sized book of interviews by Bill Powers, published by Junior in 2024 in an edition of 500. It is one of two Powers titles on the press's list, alongside his art memoir Glissando.
description.extended:
A small book of interviews about contemporary art, written by Bill Powers and issued by the independent press Junior in an edition of 500 copies.

Early 21st Century Art measures 4.5 by 7 inches and was published in 2024. The cover carries only the title, set in black capitals at the head of a pale green wrapper. Junior describes it as a book of interviews.

Junior is an independent publishing initiative based in Cleveland, Ohio, that makes limited-edition books with artists, designers and writers. Powers has a second title on its list, Glissando, an art memoir also issued in 2024 in an edition of 500. The title repeats that of a group painting exhibition, Early 21st Century Art, organized with Powers at Almine Rech, London, in 2018.

notes: Edition of 500. Binding is inferred from the publisher's cover photograph; no page count is given. Identified from a spine photograph; edition not checked against the copy.
